newsitem.title: USA: Lott on US tobacco ruling - FDA shouldn't have role.
newsitem.headline: Lott on US tobacco ruling - FDA shouldn't have role.

text.p: Senate Majority Leader Trent Lott said while he had not seen Friday's court ruling, he believed the Food and Drug Administration should not have a role in regulating tobacco.
A federal judge in North Carolina ruled that the FDA could regulate sales and labeling on cigarettes but couldn't regulate the promotion and advertising of tobacco products.
"My general disposition is no, the FDA should not have a role in regulating tobacco," Lott told reporters.
The Mississippi Republican criticized the FDA, saying the agency had not done a good job.
"We would like to have FDA reform this year," Lott said. "There's a lot of talk about what FDA's role should be in a lot of areas, including tobacco," he said.
